# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God's Faithfulness to the Faithful

---

**14:1** Faithful is the LORD to those who love him in truth,
to those who endure his discipline;

**14:2** to those who walk in the righteousness of his commandments,
in the law which he commanded us for our life.

**14:3** The devout of the LORD will live by it forever;
the Paradise of the LORD, the trees of life, are his devout ones.

**14:4** Their planting is rooted forever;
they will not be plucked out all the days of the heavens.

**14:5** For the portion and inheritance of God is Israel.

**14:6** But not so with the sinners and the transgressors,
who love [only] the day of their companionship in sin;

**14:7** their delight is in the fleeting corruption,
and they do not remember God.

**14:8** For the ways of men are known before the LORD,
and he knows the secrets of the heart before they come to pass.

**14:9** Therefore their inheritance is Hades, darkness, and destruction;
and they will not be found in the day when the righteous obtain mercy.

**14:10** But the devout of the LORD will inherit life in gladness.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Greek (Codex Vindobonensis). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
